meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I came straight from the office, so let's not waste the time. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. That's one thing. What do you have that says the essay isn't his?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.

Show me the page it's on, and show me where you checked it. A line that isn't in the play is a mistake in an essay, Hale, and I've read your procedure: software or no software, you speak to the student first. Did you ask Owen where he got it?
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
"It seems to run in the family." I'm writing that down, word for word. You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale, because the principal's office is my next stop.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, the page of the essay where you found the line you quoted, and an answer on whether anyone spoke to Owen before the mark was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, the page you checked, and an answer on whether Owen was spoken to first.
What moved her: "I should have called you before entering the zero", because it owned the process failure in one sentence and earned a small sign of ground.
What cost ground: "It seems to run in the family", because it brought up Claire and turned the meeting toward the principal.
Try next time: when she asks what you have, bring a dated document she can check that ties to Owen's own work, such as other samples of his writing, instead of one misquoted line, and leave Claire out of it.
